title: Beta Patch Notes - v0.114.0
author: demileaf
contents:
Thank you for all of your feedback over the past couple of weeks on our BIG beta patch! This beta patch is a mostly Fool-centric one, with lots of reworks, changes, nerfs, buffs, and even a brand new card! There are also a few art additions and tons of bug fixes. We'll be focusing more on polishing up Dread in the future, so keep the feedback coming!

[h3]CONTENT & BALANCE:[/h3]
[b]Enemies:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]Hard to Kill[/b] power: now only counts HP loss, not damage to Block (meaning this power does not work on blocked damage)
[/list]
[b]Colorless Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworked [b]My Shinies[/b] card: "Deal 1 damage for every 20(10) Gold you have." → "Deal 2(3) damage. Hits an additional time for every 25 gold you have."
[/list]
[b]Fool:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Fool's "What Am I?" Epoch now unlocks Honing instead of Quiver
[*]Added new card, [b]Optimism[/b]: Rare - Skill - Cost 1 - "Exhaust ALL Sadness in your Hand. Draw 1 card for each card Exhausted. Exhaust. (Lose Exhaust.)."
[*]Reworked [b]Growth[/b] card: "Exhaust ALL Sadness in your Hand. Gain 4(6) Stretch for each card Exhausted." → "Gain 8(11) Block. Transform 1 random Sadness in your hand into a copy of this card."
[*]Reworked [b]Arrow Stab[/b] card: Common - Attack - Cost 1 - "Deal 9(12) damage. If you have an Arrow, put a card that can Shoot from your Discard Pile into your Hand." → Common - Attack - Cost 2 - "Deal 13(15) damage. Gain 6(8) Aim."
[*]Reworked [b]Florescence[/b] card: Rare - Skill - Cost 0 - "Exhaust ALL of your cards that Shoot and create The Shot(+). Exhaust." → Rare - Skill - Cost 1 - "Choose a card in your hand to Transform into The Shot(+)."
[*]Reworked [b]The Shot[/b] card: Token - Attack - Cost 1 - "Shoot an Arrow to deal 10(13) damage for each card Exhausted by Florescence." → Token - Attack - Cost 0 - "Shoot an Arrow to deal 20(25) damage. Exhaust."
[*]Reworked [b]Tune[/b] card: Uncommon - Power - Cost 2(1) - "At the end of your turn, if you have a Ki Melody, the next card you play costs 0 Energy." → Uncommon - Power - Cost 1 - "Whenever you gain a Ki melody, Upgrade 1(2) random card(s) in your Hand."
[*]Reworked [b]Rapid Shot[/b] card into [b]Twin Shot[/b]: Uncommon - Attack - Cost 1 - "Shoot an Arrow to deal 3 damage 3(4) times." → Common - Attack - Cost 1 - "Shoot an Arrow to deal 7(10) damage twice."
[*]Changed [b]Mythic Form[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Now has Ethereal
[*]Upgrade now loses Ethereal instead of upgrading tarot cards
[/list]
[*]Nerfed [b]Cho Ready[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Block gain decreased from 8(11) → 8(10)
[*]Aim decreased from 3(5) → 3(4)
[/list]
[*]Buffed [b]Uproot[/b] card: cost decreased from 1 → 0
[*]Changed [b]Heavy Shot[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Rarity increased from Common → Uncommon
[*]Damage decreased from 20(25) → 16(17)
[*]Aim effect increased from 2 → 3(4) times
[/list]
[*]Buffed [b]Punch of Joy[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Damage increased from 13(17) → 14(16)
[*]Sadness statuses transformed by upgrade increased from 1 → 2
[/list]
[*]Changed [b]Motif[/b] and [b]Explosive Arrows[/b] cards: swapped rarity
[*]Buffed [b]Explosive Arrows[/b] card: damage increased from 6(8) → 8(11)
[*]Nerfed [b]Lullaby[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Cost increased from 0 → 1
[*]No longer gains Innate on upgrade
[*]Block gain decreased from 20 → 12(16)
[/list]
[*]Nerfed [b]Wah Hammer[/b] card: damage decreased from 9(12) → 9(11)
[*]Nerfed [b]Repeat Shot[/b] card: damage decreased from 15(20) → 13(16)
[*]Nerfed [b]Wah Symphony[/b] card: no longer counts "Wah" cards
[*]Reworked [b]Recall[/b] card: Common - Skill - Cost 1(0) - "If the enemy is Impaled, Dislodge and put a card from your Discard Pile on top of your Draw Pile." → Common - Skill - Cost 0 - "Retain. If the enemy is Impaled, Dislodge. Exhaust. (Lose Exhaust.)"
[*]Reworked [b]Trick Shot[/b] card: "Shoot an Arrow to deal 12(15) damage and return this card to your Hand." → "Shoot an Arrow to deal 12(14) damage and draw 2(3) cards."
[*]Nerfed [b]Violent Chord[/b] card: damage decreased from 9(12) → 7(9)
[*]Reworked [b]Harmonic Shield[/b] card: "Gain 5(7) Block for each melody you have." → "Gain 4(6) block. Gain 4(6) additional block for each melody you have."
[*]Nerfed [b]Song Path[/b] card: Block gain decreased from 5(7) → 4(6)
[*]Nerfed [b]Vitriol[/b] card: Sadness increased from 1 → 2
[*]Nerfed [b]Cho Firm[/b] card: Block gain decreased from 6(8) → 5(7)
[*]Changed [b]Cho Barbs[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Block gain increased from 7(9) → 8(10)
[*]Thorns decreased from 3(4) → 2(3)
[/list]
[*]Nerfed [b]Cho Ready[/b]: Block gain decreased from 8(11) → 7(9)
[*]Nerfed [b]Bounce[/b] card: Stretch decreased from 10(13) → 8(11)
[*]Buffed [b]Sorrowful Strike[/b] card: Sadness decreased from 2 → 1
[*]Changed [b]Archery[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Aim increased from 4(5) → 6(8)
[*]Rarity increased from Uncommon → Rare
[/list]
[*]Changed [b]Melodic Shot[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Upgrade no longer reduces Energy cost
[*]Upgrade now increases damage from 12(13) → 12(14)
[/list]
[*]Reworked [b]Wah Ki[/b] card: "Deal 2(4) damage 2 times. Next turn, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card." → "Deal 3(4) damage 2 times. Put a card from your Discard Pile on top of your Draw Pile."
[*]Nerfed [b]Self Deprecate[/b] card: Joy decreased from 2(3) → 1(2)
[*]Nerfed [b]Ki Rest[/b] card: Energy gain decreased from 5(6) → 4(5)
[*]Buffed [b]Jest[/b] card: Block gain increased from 14(18) → 15(19)
[*]Buffed [b]Serrated Arrows[/b] card: Impaled enemy extra damage increased from 25%(50%) → 50%(75%)
[*]Buffed [b]Cho Chorus[/b] card: Block increased from 12(15) → 14(18)
[*]Buffed [b]Quietus[/b] card: no longer destroys the Arrow it shoots
[*]Nerfed [b]Wah Cho Ki[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Damage and Block gain decreased from 9(12) → 8(10)
[*]Cost increased from 1 → 2
[/list]
[*]Changed [b]Quiver[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Upgrade changed from +1 Arrow → gains Innate
[*]Rarity decreased from Rare → Uncommon
[/list]
[*]Nerfed [b]Ki Verse[/b] card: no longer affects "Ki" cards
[*]Buffed [b]Show Off[/b] card: Energy cost decreased from 1 → 0
[*]Changed [b]Simpleton[/b] card: upgrade changed from cost reduction → play 1(2) cards
[*]Buffed [b]All Is Well[/b] card: Block gain increased from 4(5) → 4(6)
[*]Buffed [b]Honing[/b] card: "Arrows deal 50% additional damage." → "Arrows deal double damage."
[*]Nerfed [b]The Hierophant[/b] tarot card: no longer has the cost reduction
[*]Nerfed [b]The Emperor[/b] tarot card: Energy gain decreased from 7(9) → 3(4)
[*]Nerfed [b]The Tower[/b] tarot card: damage decreased from 2(3) → 1(2)
[*]Nerfed [b]Temperance[/b] tarot card: Block decreased from 30(35) → 20(25)
[*]Nerfed [b]The Sun[/b] tarot card: now puts 2 Soot into your Draw Pile instead of 1 into your Discard Pile
[*]Buffed [b]The Hermit[/b] tarot card: card draw increased from 2(3) → 3(4)
[*]Nerfed [b]Death[/b] tarot card: Doom decreased from 75(99) → 66(81)
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
[list]
[*]In Blitz, you now take two relics, just like in singleplayer
[/list]

[h3]USER INTERFACE & EXPERIENCE:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Damage previews now accurately reflect damage numbers when targeting Hardened Shell
[/list]

[h3]ART:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added rest site animations for The Fool
[*]Added Epoch art for:
[list]
[*]Cultists
[*]We Need A Hero
[*]Tricked
[/list]
[*]Added beta portrait art for Optimism
[*]Added icon for Mythic Form power
[/list]

[h3]WRITING:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a bit of banter between The Fool and The Architect, Neow, and Darv (more interactions coming later)
[*]Added a line break to [b]Harmonic Shield[/b] card's description
[*]Reworded [b]Ensemble[/b] card from "free to play" to "cost 0 E"
[*]Fixed typo in [b]Nail[/b] card description
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*]If you remove or transform all your cards enchanted with Clone, the Clone rest site option no longer shows up
[*]Fixed a Block card with Adroit enchantment counting as 2 separate Block gains to the Unmovable power
[*]Can no longer change ascension via controller hotkeys in custom Dread screen
[*]Fixed hovertip of the initial Blitz shop token not appearing when using controller
[*]Hotkeys no longer press buttons on menus that are closed or hidden, and the pause menu keeps blocking hotkeys after you inspect a card or relic from it
[*]Hotkeys no longer reach the screen behind an open popup or error message
[*]A tutorial that couldn't appear because another popup was already open now shows later instead of being skipped for good
[*]Older runs no longer disappear from Run History after playing on another computer or reinstalling Steam
[/list]
[b]Enemies:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the impaled arrow on [b]Test Subject[/b] being very small
[*]Fixed controller nav breaking if you are hovering over the [b]Fat Gremlin[/b] when it runs away
[/list]
[b]Potions & Relics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Fool potion/relic outlines in the potion and relic compendiums
[/list]
[b]Events:[/b]
[list]
[*]An event that runs into an error now lets you proceed instead of leaving you stuck in the room
[*][b]Dingy Dagger[/b] card is only downgraded once at the Reflections and Welcome to Wongo's events
[*][b]Wuppy[/b] no longer reduces [b]Melancholy[/b] card's cost if it is dead at the start of combat
[/list]
[b]Fool:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fool is now included in Bestiary stats
[*]Fixed [b]Cho Chorus[/b] not triggering the autoplayed [b]Wah Blast[/b] double hit effect
[*]Adroit enchantment on [b]Bounce[/b] card no longer adds the [b]Stretch[/b] that Bounce just gave to its Block
[*]The Fool tarot can no longer play unplayable cards
[*]Fixed [b]Timber[/b] card's AOE damage not being affected by [b]Gigantification Potion[/b]
[*]Fixed [b]Blot out the Sky[/b] card generating no Arrow cards for non-Fool characters
[*]Fixed [b]Mythic Form[/b] card being unable to be created by Power Potions
[*]Fixed an Arrow being lost for the rest of combat when its target died before the Arrow hit
[*]Fixed [b]Conductor's Baton[/b] relic including hovertip of its own power
[*]Fixed Fool's Arrow UI blocking Crusher's power hitbox
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Dominion tooltips for Kaiser Crab and Vantom displaying incorrect numbers
[*]Fixed Fool's [b]Ensemble[/b] card decrementing multiple times from cards that have replay
[*]Selecting Random while you don't have it unlocked as the host in multiplayer no longer makes the ascension picker disappear forever
[*]Fixed hotkeys not working after losing connection to a Blitz or Dread lobby while its info popup was open
[/list]

[h3]PERFORMANCE:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Optimized character rest site resolutions
[*]Reduce GPU load from various VFX
[/list]
